catalog.title: 1974 Seiko Catalog Vol.1
catalog.note: JDM catalog, companion to Vol.2. The front photo spreads (scan pages 1–16, watches on blue and red backgrounds) print a short price list per page — ref with jewels (石) and number, case material (18K金側 = 18K gold, 18Kホワイトゴールド側 = 18K white gold) and price; on the red pages the prices are labels pasted over the printed ones, and the faint grey type there is partly illegible (two refs and one price left blank). The grid pages print under each photo the model, jewels and number (e.g. '24MLW 23石 R-103' → ref 24MLW-R-103, the full line kept in `code`), the line name and feature lines (translated into `notes`), the case material·WR (SS, SGP, TSGP, WGP, WGPG, ASGP/AWGP/APDP/ACRP A-grade plated, PDP, SILV, GC, AGF, HSS, NSB, ALM, 14K/18K, 14K·WG; ·RP = rainproof, kept in `wr`) and the price (円), then a small <NNN-NNN> code, kept as `caseDialCode`. A four-digit model (2220, 2411, 6117, 1944 …) is the movement and is stored as `caliber`; family codes (56LMW, 61-5A, 11S, 17QSL, 89ST …) leave it blank and no CCCC-NNNN case refs or bracelet codes are printed. Pencilled dealer marks are ignored; a printed price struck through with a new one written in is kept as both. Scan index = printed page up to 23; the scan skips printed pages 24, 31, 32, 36, 38, 46, 57–60, 68–70, 78, 80, 85, 86, 94–96, 100, 105, 106, 120–124, 126, 129, 130, 134–136, 142–144, 152–154 and 165–168, and ends at printed page 176 (no back cover); the page labels carry the printed numbers. The file 1974/1974-seiko-catalog-v1-jp.pdf is a second scan of the same 133 pages and was not digitised separately.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders (Oct 2026): every pictured watch boxed (panel-aware detector plus hand-set boxes, checked on per-page sheets) and every caption read and then verified against 300–900 DPI caption crops of the PDF.
